name: Orbit
tag: A bold identity for forward thinkers.
headline: A new perspective. A distinctive identity.
challenge: Explore how a technology brand can communicate momentum and confidence without relying on familiar tech clichés.
approach: Build the identity around an orbital motif and a precise, expressive wordmark. Pair deep indigo with luminous blue to balance credibility and energy.
scope: Brand positioning · Logo system · Visual identity · Brand guidelines
deliver: A flexible visual language for presentations, digital communication, and brand launches.

gallery.label: 01 / Brand mark
gallery.headline: A mark with momentum.
gallery.body: A clear wordmark and orbital symbol create a flexible signature for the brand.

gallery.label: 02 / Colour & typography
gallery.headline: Confident in every setting.
gallery.body: Deep indigo, electric blue, and a direct type system balance trust with forward energy.

gallery.label: 03 / Business card
gallery.headline: The identity, up close.
gallery.body: A simple, tactile application of the visual system for first meetings and introductions.

name: Forma
tag: Spaces for the way you live.
headline: An architectural vision, translated online.
challenge: Create a clear digital journey for a conceptual architecture studio, helping visitors explore projects and understand its design philosophy.
approach: Use an editorial project grid, generous whitespace, and a simple enquiry journey. Let work lead the experience across desktop and mobile.
scope: Website strategy · UX/UI design · Responsive layouts
deliver: A website design concept covering the homepage, project archive, project details, and enquiry flow.

gallery.label: 01 / Homepage
gallery.headline: Spaces for the way you live.
gallery.body: A calm introduction gives the studio's point of view room to breathe.

gallery.label: 02 / Projects
gallery.headline: Considered spaces. Real life.
gallery.body: A visual project archive helps visitors find the work that speaks to them.

gallery.label: 03 / Project detail
gallery.headline: Every space has a story.
gallery.body: Project details pair strong imagery with clear context and a direct path to enquire.

name: Morrow
headline: Everyday rituals. An unmistakable personality.
challenge: Develop a warm, recognisable identity for a conceptual lifestyle brand that should feel thoughtful and approachable.
approach: Combine a characterful editorial wordmark with sun-warmed colour and simple, expressive compositions. Establish a consistent system rather than a standalone logo.
scope: Brand strategy · Visual identity · Art direction · Brand guidelines
deliver: An identity direction with adaptable typography, colour, and visual applications.

gallery.label: 01 / Brand mark
gallery.headline: A brighter everyday.
gallery.body: A soft, expressive wordmark gives Morrow a familiar, optimistic feel.

gallery.label: 02 / Colour & typography
gallery.headline: Warmth with a point of view.
gallery.body: Sunlit tones and editorial lettering create an ownable world for everyday rituals.

gallery.label: 03 / Brand application
gallery.headline: Small details, held together.
gallery.body: A branded letterhead carries the identity into practical business communication.

name: Vale
headline: A calmer path from discovery to enquiry.
challenge: Design an approachable website experience for a conceptual wellness business, making services and next steps easy to understand.
approach: Organise services around visitor needs, use reassuring visual hierarchy, and create a direct route to an appointment enquiry.
scope: Information architecture · UX/UI design · Mobile website design
deliver: A responsive website concept with service discovery, service detail layouts, and a clear contact journey.

gallery.label: 01 / Homepage
gallery.headline: Care that starts with you.
gallery.body: A reassuring landing page sets the tone and makes the first step feel simple.

gallery.label: 02 / Services
gallery.headline: Find the support you need.
gallery.body: Clear service summaries help visitors compare options without feeling overwhelmed.

gallery.label: 03 / Appointment
gallery.headline: Your next step, made clear.
gallery.body: A focused enquiry screen explains what happens next and invites a conversation.

name: Rooted
headline: Natural character. A coherent brand system.
challenge: Express a conceptual wellbeing brand through a distinctive identity that feels grounded without becoming visually generic.
approach: Create an organic symbol system, confident typography, and a restrained green palette. Keep each element useful across brand touchpoints.
scope: Brand direction · Logo design · Visual identity · Brand applications
deliver: A cohesive brand identity concept spanning marks, colour, typography, and digital brand assets.

gallery.label: 01 / Brand mark
gallery.headline: Rooted in something good.
gallery.body: A simple botanical mark gives the wellbeing brand a distinct and grounded signature.

gallery.label: 02 / Colour & typography
gallery.headline: Natural, never ordinary.
gallery.body: A fresh green palette and confident type system make the identity feel clear and contemporary.

gallery.label: 03 / Team ID card
gallery.headline: A brand people can wear.
gallery.body: An adaptable staff ID card shows how the identity can extend to the people behind the business.

approach: Develop a clear brand voice and expressive identity, then carry both into a website built around expertise, services, and an enquiry journey.

deliver: An integrated brand and website concept showing how strategy can connect every visitor touchpoint.

gallery.label: 03 / Services

gallery.label: 03 / Invoice
